# Tall Poppy Studio

> Tall Poppy Studio is an independent software studio in Budapest, Hungary, run by Akos Komuves. It makes native iOS and Mac apps, web products and open-source AI developer tools, and builds software for clients.

Contact: akos@tallpoppystudio.com. Website: https://tallpoppystudio.com/. Last updated: 2026-10-13.

## Key pages

- [Apps](https://tallpoppystudio.com/apps/): every app, with status and platforms
- [Client work](https://tallpoppystudio.com/work/): services, current client work (under NDA) and previous teams (Tier, ABC News, Queensland Police Service, Liven)
- [Open source](https://tallpoppystudio.com/open-source/): MCP servers and agent skills
- [About](https://tallpoppystudio.com/about/): Akos Komuves and the studio
- [Now](https://tallpoppystudio.com/now/): current focus, dated
- [Press kit](https://tallpoppystudio.com/press/): boilerplate, mark, icons
- [Writing](https://tallpoppystudio.com/writing/): notes on building and growing apps with AI agents

## Apps

- [WikiCatch](https://tallpoppystudio.com/wikicatch/): a fishing spots map app for iPhone. Live; iOS. Website: https://wikicatch.app. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6758548046.
- [WikiHunt](https://tallpoppystudio.com/wikihunt/): a GPS hunting map app for iPhone. Live; iOS. Website: https://wikihunt.app. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760655517.
- [NoteHunter](https://tallpoppystudio.com/notehunter/): an ear training and music theory app for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Live; iOS, iPadOS, macOS. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id1584522362.
- [MeritValue](https://tallpoppystudio.com/meritvalue/): a stock valuation service on the web and iPhone that computes intrinsic value from SEC filings. Live; Web, iOS, MCP. Website: https://www.meritvalue.com. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6795664202.
- [Kufu](https://tallpoppystudio.com/kufu/): a workout tracker for iPhone and Apple Watch that combines gym strength training with calisthenics. Live; iOS, watchOS. Website: https://kufuapp.com. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760716466.
- [Matchframe](https://tallpoppystudio.com/matchframe/): an AI dating photo coach for iPhone. Live; iOS. Website: https://matchframe.app. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759290521.
- [Kumano](https://tallpoppystudio.com/kumano/): a Mac app that adds a product-management layer to agentic development with Claude Code. Beta; macOS. Website: https://kumano.app.
- [Invention Capture](https://tallpoppystudio.com/invention-capture/): an iPhone app that turns a spoken description and photos of an invention into a structured invention disclosure, on the device. Live; iOS. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6778804651.
- [Kotone](https://tallpoppystudio.com/kotone/): a website for listening to traditional music of Japan and China from public-domain and Creative Commons recordings. Live; Web. Website: https://kotone.co.
- [SHRD](https://tallpoppystudio.com/shrd/): a taxi-sharing app for iPhone and Android. Live; iOS, Android. Website: https://www.shrdapp.com. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6755481627.
- [Gaiwan](https://tallpoppystudio.com/gaiwan/): a gongfu tea timer and tea journal for iPhone. Live; iOS. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6814422371.
- [Tuuvi](https://tallpoppystudio.com/tuuvi/): a sun care app for families on iPhone. Maintained; iOS. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6752693234.
- [SensorCam RAW](https://tallpoppystudio.com/sensorcam/): an iPhone camera app for open gate video and 48 MP ProRAW photos. Beta; iOS.
- [Kranked](https://tallpoppystudio.com/kranked/): an App Store keyword tracker for iPhone. Live; iOS. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6755593681.

## Open source

- [appstoreconnect-mcp](https://github.com/akoskomuves/appstoreconnect-mcp): An MCP server for the App Store Connect API. MIT. Install: `npx -y @akoskomuves/appstoreconnect-mcp`.
- [kranked-mcp](https://github.com/akoskomuves/kranked): App Store keyword research for your AI coding assistant. MIT. Install: `claude mcp add kranked -- uvx kranked-mcp`.
- [aso-cross-localization](https://github.com/akoskomuves/aso-cross-localization): A Claude Code skill for App Store cross-localization. MIT.
- [meritvalue-skills](https://github.com/akoskomuves/meritvalue-skills): Skills for valuing public companies like an owner. MIT.

## Writing

- [I taught Claude Code the App Store trick almost no indie uses](https://tallpoppystudio.com/writing/indexed-titles/) (2026-10-13): Cross-localization is an App Store optimisation technique: every storefront also indexes metadata from localizations its shoppers never see, so filling those hidden titles, subtitles and keyword fields multiplies the words that rank in one market. Here is how it works, and the Claude Code setup (one skill, three MCP servers) that does it end to end.

## Support

Each app's page on this site links to its support and privacy pages. All support email goes to akos@tallpoppystudio.com and is answered by Akos.
